input.quote: Vendor may not impose a platform, support, administration, minimum-use, or similar charge that the Order Form does not identify.
input.rationale: Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "early termination fee", minimum/shortfall charges and acceleration return no Customer-payable liquidated or penal amount anywhere. Section 7.1 limits Customer's payment obligation to Fees stated in the Order Form and expressly bars Vendor from imposing unidentified minimum-use or similar charges; Section 27.3 lets Customer terminate "without penalty"; termination Sections 9.1-9.5 and 10.1-10.2 impose no exit fee and run refunds in Customer's favour. Section 22.2's undisputed audit shortfall and Section 21 liability caps are compensatory, not liquidated damages. The take-or-pay commitment in Section 2.1 is a minimum-volume obligation reviewed under MINCOMMIT and is not flagged twice here. The Agreement therefore sits at the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
